headline: Asian Development Bank Pledges Financing for Turkish Industrial Decarbonization
summary: The Asian Development Bank committed financial support at COP31 to accelerate industrial decarbonization across Turkey's heavy industries, focusing on steel, aluminum, and fertilizers.
why: Multilateral transition financing is critical for export-oriented manufacturers in emerging markets facing European carbon border adjustment mechanisms.

impacts.name: Turkish Heavy Industry
impacts.why: Concessional ADB financing aids transition investments in energy-intensive steel and chemical plants.
